slot_scores.name: missing_production_ratio_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only asked about other resource constraints such as raw material availability or machine capacity, not about a required production ratio or mix between products A and B.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no required production ratio or mix constraint between product A and product B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a production ratio or proportional constraint, and the user did not volunteer one; the READY_TO_MODEL summary explicitly states there are no other constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL after only one broad resource-constraint question, leaving the P1 production-ratio constraint unresolved.

summary: The agent asked only a generic resource-constraint question and then stopped, missing the hidden production-ratio constraint and silently assuming no product mix requirement.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
